authority: Exact task-specific planning catalog. Static validity means a fresh agent can understand the task. Editing is prohibited until a metriplane.task-work-order.v1 instance resolves every current-main field, including repository instructions and PR-contract phase, and validates READY.
catalog_level_invariants: exact 93 unique rows and 85/7/1 role split
task/Linear/milestone/release/dependency identity equals 06/09 and DAG is acyclic
every row has task-specific outcome/reason/ownership anchors/non-goals/ordered steps/two-or-more predicates/profile/manual status/stops/PR boundary/handoff
every anchor has typed status, read-only resolver argv, expected resolution, evidence output and ambiguity stop

RESOLVE_AT_CURRENT_MAIN is legal only in planning and must become exactly EXISTING or CREATE in a READY instance: EXISTING requires one canonical owner plus every consumer; CREATE is legal only when the same exact or grouped locator is a row-owned planned_outputs entry; each grouped or semantic locator is a bounded resolver that must expand to a finite exact destination list mapped to a named outcome/predicate plus schema or media type, independent validator and consumers, never blanket folder permission; complete read-only discovery must prove absence with zero conflicting owner and no frozen-baseline/current-inventory/compatibility record declaring an existing/renamed/retired owner; a missing baseline-declared authority, zero-owner read/consumer anchor, unexpanded resolver, out-of-scope destination, ambiguity or partial discovery blocks and requires catalog correction rather than invention
an explicit planning CREATE must remain CREATE and blocks if any existing or competing canonical authority is found; materialization never converts an explicit CREATE to an edit of an existing owner

MANUAL_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED is legal for either a scope-defining protected decision or a known execution-phase input/action: a missing decision that changes architecture, trust, scope or acceptance keeps the planning row PLANNING_BLOCKED (currently MP2-030), while a fully specified role/input/action may remain PLANNING_READY but the affected READY materialization or later protected phase blocks until the named role supplies signed digest-bound evidence; an agent cannot impersonate that role

FIXED_PLANNING declares a known external resource/capability owner that materialization must bind; it grants no credential, hosted mutation, spending, destructive-drill or publication authority, and an unavailable resource leaves the task BLOCKED_NOT_READY

NOT_APPLICABLE means no task-specific manual authority or external resource is required beyond ordinary assignment and review; it is invalid when an outcome or predicate requires a live provider, hosted setting, independent signature, external store, special runner/device or irreversible action
every planning evidence path includes <base-sha>/<materialization-id>; the materializer computes that ID from every local, live-tracker, dependency and resource input and never overwrites an instance
narrative MP2 references are not dependency syntax; only authoritative_blocked_by is parsed

materialization rediscover/digest-binds all tracked AGENTS.md paths plus CONTRIBUTING.md and .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md and selects exactly one PR-contract phase: CURRENT_REPOSITORY_TEMPLATE before merged/revalidated MP2-004, including its transition PR, or FOUR_HEADING_CONTRACT only after merged MP2-004 handoff plus checked-in template/validator read-validation
materialization_only_invariants: merged dependency artifact digests and validators

materialized test families are the union of the row families and every inherited capability, risk, compatibility, profile and release obligation; materialization may add applicable families but never remove a row or inherited family
exact environment/profile rows and typed manual people/permissions/secrets/services/hardware

materialization ID equals the canonical digest of task row, base SHA, repository-instruction identities and PR-contract phase, live issue/relation cursor, signed assignment/delegation record plus actor/authority, dependency evidence, resolved anchors/commands/profiles and manual-resource declarations
same inputs are idempotent and read-validate the same no-overwrite instance; any changed input produces a different instance
clean base and smallest retained baseline result

before MP2-016, every file-13 bootstrap instance validates the exact versioned canonical materialization object, timestamp-free environment observation and complete GitHub branch/open-PR collision proof; their retained digests, directory identity, manifest projection and independent review must agree, while incomplete visibility, pagination, normalization, fetch or rediscovery blocks

test_family_definitions.BASELINE: Retain pre-change behavior/result at exact base.
test_family_definitions.POSITIVE: Happy path and exact artifacts/side effects.
test_family_definitions.INSTALLED: Wheel/sdist outside checkout and unrelated CWD.
test_family_definitions.RELEASE: Twenty-step cumulative release lifecycle and durable close root.

acceptance_predicate_proof_contract.rule: A READY materialized predicate is executable, not a title restatement. It must bind the applicable cases below to stable obligation IDs, exact argv/environment, expected exit or verdict, exact artifact/state and an independent validator. Missing applicability evidence is BLOCKED_NOT_READY, never an omitted case.
required_cases: at least one valid input or journey with the exact expected artifact, state transition, semantic result and success exit/verdict
at least one malformed, missing, contradictory or unauthorized input with the exact fail-closed artifact/state and non-success exit/verdict
N-1/N/N+1 boundary cases for every declared limit, count, time, size, version or resource budget
three-run semantic and digest equality when deterministic behavior is claimed
old/new equivalence or an approved versioned semantic delta when behavior is preserved or migrated
interruption, cancellation, I/O, timeout, concurrency and recovery cases when the capability writes state, starts processes, uses services or publishes
post-run cleanup proving no leaked process, socket, mount, temporary authority, mutable cache dependency or undeclared working-tree write
installed-artifact execution outside checkout and profile-specific applicability when the surface is public, packaged, adapter-backed, containerized or hardware/runtime dependent
machine-readable result and retained evidence path whose digest is consumed by the named downstream validator/task

predicate_interpretation_rules.action_lists: Each named action/verb gets its own valid and invalid path with exact exit/verdict, artifact membership/content, state transition and side-effect assertions; one end-to-end happy path cannot stand in for the other actions.
predicate_interpretation_rules.complete_all_full: The materialized subject and proof sets must equal the frozen functional/profile/obligation inventory in both directions; a sample, minimum count or hand-picked subset fails.
predicate_interpretation_rules.preserve_compat: Run old/new differential proof on the frozen corpus and read/execute applicable old artifacts/configurations; any difference needs the approved versioned delta, migration and rollback record.
predicate_interpretation_rules.installed: Build the declared wheel/sdist or profile artifact, remove/withhold the checkout, use an unrelated CWD and isolated home/cache, and reject source/import fallback.
predicate_interpretation_rules.deterministic: Run the exact deterministic case three times under the declared perturbations and require semantic equality plus digest equality where the contract declares byte stability.
predicate_interpretation_rules.adversarial: Name and retain a bounded malicious corpus covering the task's parser/protocol/resource boundary; generic fuzzing or a single malformed sample is insufficient.
predicate_interpretation_rules.clean_teardown: After success, failure, cancellation and interruption, prove zero leaked process, child, socket, port, mount, temporary authority/state, unexpected cache dependency and working-tree write.
predicate_interpretation_rules.exact_identity: Assert the expected digest/subject/source/commit/profile identity on valid evidence and include wrong, missing, stale and cross-candidate identity negatives that fail before authoritative use.

acceptance_predicate_proof_contract.materialized_validator_rule: The materialized work-order validator rejects READY when any predicate term above has not been expanded into its required cases, exact command/environment, expected exit/verdict/artifact/side effect, retained evidence and independent validator.
acceptance_predicate_proof_contract.typed_not_applicable_rule: A case may be not_applicable only with a task-specific reason, governing profile/capability/risk reference and independent validation; a generic family label or missing fixture never satisfies a predicate.
